description: This file defines HTTP handlers and related types for processing workflow execution events emitted by agents within a larger system. It includes definitions for request payloads, event processing logic, and functions to build or update execution records in a data store.

methods.name: WorkflowExecutionEventHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler function that processes incoming workflow execution events, creating or updating execution records in the provided store.

methods.name: buildExecutionRecordFromEvent
methods.description: Constructs a new execution record based on incoming event data, setting timestamps and default values.

methods.name: applyEventToExecution
methods.description: Updates an existing execution record with new event information, adjusting status, timestamps, and other relevant fields.

methods.name: marshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes a given value into JSON.RawMessage, returning nil if the value is nil or marshaling fails.

methods.name: firstNonEmpty
methods.description: Returns the first non-empty string from a list of strings.
